# CARFAX
> CARFAX is an automotive marketplace and vehicle history platform for shopping, buying, owning, and selling cars with confidence.

CARFAX combines used and new car listings, vehicle history reports, ownership tools, valuation, repair-shop discovery, and car research. Its core experience centers on free CARFAX Reports in listings, paid vehicle history reports, maintenance tracking, and research tools for comparing brands, models, and vehicle values.

## Core Platform
- [CARFAX Home](https://www.carfax.com): Main entry point for car shopping, selling, ownership tools, and vehicle history services.
- [Used Cars for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Search used car listings with free CARFAX Reports, filters, photos, and dealer inventory.
- [New Cars for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/new-cars): Browse new car inventory by make, model, location, and dealer availability.
- [Vehicle History Reports](https://www.carfax.com/vehicle-history-reports/): Purchase CARFAX Reports with accident, title, ownership, and service history details.
- [Car Research](https://www.carfax.com/car-research): Research vehicles by make, model, body style, rankings, and buying guidance.
- [Used Car Values](https://www.carfax.com/value/): Estimate vehicle value for trade-in, private sale, or purchase decisions.
- [Find a Service Shop](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair): Locate repair shops and service centers near you.
- [Track Your Car's Maintenance](https://www.carfax.com/Service/): Manage maintenance records, reminders, and ownership information for your vehicle.

## Vehicle History Reports
- [CARFAX Vehicle History Reports](https://www.carfax.com/vehicle-history-reports/): Overview of CARFAX Reports and what history data is included.
- [VIN Check and Lookup](https://www.carfax.com/vehicle-history-reports/): Access vehicle history information using a VIN before buying a car.
- [Used Car Listings with Free CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Shop listings that include free report access directly from search results.
- [CARFAX Value](https://www.carfax.com/value/): Use history-aware valuation tools alongside report data to assess pricing.
- [Support Center](https://support.carfax.com/home): Get help with reports, purchases, accounts, and common CARFAX questions.

## Car Shopping
- [Used Cars for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Main used vehicle marketplace with filters for price, mileage, and vehicle features.
- [New Cars for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/new-cars): Search new inventory from dealers by location and brand.
- [Search by Brand](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Start shopping by make across used and new inventory categories.
- [Used Car Brands](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Explore used inventory from major automakers and model lines.
- [New Car Brands](https://www.carfax.com/new-cars): Browse new vehicles by manufacturer and current dealer listings.
- [Need Help Finding a Car?](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Use marketplace tools to narrow options by budget, body style, and history.

## Selling and Valuation
- [Used Car Values](https://www.carfax.com/value/): Get an estimated market value for your current vehicle.
- [Sell Your Car](https://www.carfax.com/value/): Start with valuation and ownership details to prepare for selling.
- [Trade-In Value](https://www.carfax.com/value/): Check estimated trade-in pricing before visiting a dealer.
- [Private Sale Value](https://www.carfax.com/value/): Compare value expectations for private-party selling scenarios.
- [Vehicle History Reports](https://www.carfax.com/vehicle-history-reports/): Review report details that can influence resale value and buyer confidence.

## Ownership and Maintenance
- [CARFAX Car Care / Service](https://www.carfax.com/Service/): Track maintenance, service history, and ownership tasks in one place.
- [Find a Service Shop](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair): Discover nearby repair facilities and maintenance providers.
- [Already Own a Car?](https://www.carfax.com/Service/): Access ownership tools for reminders, records, and service planning.
- [Track Your Car's Maintenance](https://www.carfax.com/Service/): Maintain a digital record of completed and upcoming service.
- [Service and Repair Search](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair): Find shops by location for routine maintenance and repairs.

## Research and Rankings
- [Car Research](https://www.carfax.com/car-research): Central hub for vehicle research, model information, and shopping guidance.
- [Best Sedans](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-sedans): Ranked sedan recommendations with category comparisons and buying context.
- [Best Pickup Trucks](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-pickup-trucks): Rankings and comparisons for pickup trucks across major segments.
- [Best SUVs for the Money](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-suvs-for-money): SUV rankings focused on value, features, and overall appeal.
- [Best Electric Cars](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-electric-cars): Research top EVs with comparisons on range, price, and practicality.
- [Best Hybrids](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-hybrids): Compare hybrid vehicles by efficiency, features, and category.
- [Best Gas Mileage SUVs](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-gas-mileage-suv): Review fuel-efficient SUV options for economy-focused shoppers.

- [Used Ford for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/Used-Ford_m7): View used Ford inventory across popular models and body styles.
- [Used Honda for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/Used-Honda_m12): Shop used Honda vehicles with pricing, photos, and history information.
- [Used Toyota for Sale](https://www.carfax.com/Used-Toyota_m32): Browse used Toyota listings with free CARFAX Reports.
- [New Cars by Brand](https://www.carfax.com/new-cars): Discover new inventory organized by make and local availability.

## Support
- [CARFAX Help Center](https://support.carfax.com/home): Official support portal for reports, accounts, billing, and product help.
- [CARFAX Home](https://www.carfax.com): Return to the main site for shopping, ownership, and report tools.
- [Vehicle History Reports](https://www.carfax.com/vehicle-history-reports/): Product page for report-related questions and purchase paths.
- [CARFAX Car Care / Service](https://www.carfax.com/Service/): Ownership tool entry point for maintenance and account-related tasks.
- [Auto Repair](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair): Support path for finding and using repair-shop search features.
